# ROMAC Blog

> > Your essential guide to Rome: vacation rentals, neighborhood guides, dining, day trips, and insider tips for experiencing the Eternal City.

ROMAC Blog is the official travel resource for ROMAC vacation rentals in Rome, offering comprehensive guides to Rome's neighborhoods (Testaccio, Campo de' Fiori, Trastevere), practical travel information, dining recommendations, and curated experiences for visitors staying in Rome apartments.

## Key Topics

- Rome vacation rentals
- Campo de' Fiori neighborhood
- Testaccio district
- Piazza Navona
- Rome public transportation (ATAC)
- Vatican City
- Trastevere
- Villa Borghese
- Piazza di Spagna
- Rome restaurants and dining
- Day trips from Rome
- Rome wedding planning
- Tourist passes (Roma Pass, Omnia Card)
- Rome neighborhoods guides
- Seasonal Rome travel

## Essential Travel Guides

- [Getting around with Rome Public Transportation](https://blog.stayromac.com/rome-public-transportation-tickets): Guide to ATAC metro, buses & tickets for Rome public transportation
- [Diferencia entre Omnia y Roma pass](https://blog.stayromac.com/comparacion-roma-pass-omnia-card): Comparison of Roma Pass vs Omnia Card tourist passes for Vatican & museums
- [Las 15 maneras de disfrutar Roma con poco dinero](https://blog.stayromac.com/roma-15-maneras-disfrutar-roma-sin-gastar-dinero): 15 budget-friendly ways to enjoy Rome: free museums, Trevi, Pantheon
- [Rome in November: What To Do and What To Expect](https://blog.stayromac.com/november-in-rome): November Rome guide: weather, packing tips, museums & indoor activities
- [Christmas in Rome | Guide by ROMAC](https://blog.stayromac.com/christmas-rome-guide-by-romac): Christmas guide: holiday sweets, shopping, La Befana & vacation rentals
